metadata.description: Use GitHub as an agent control plane: stacked draft PRs, fixup-based review replies, and self-improving CLAUDE.md rules.

plugins.name: github-os
plugins.description: Slice a finished feature branch into a stack of single-purpose draft PRs, address review comments with git commit --fixup + git rebase --autosquash, and mine repeat offenses into CLAUDE.md rules and new skills.
